description: This file defines a User entity class and a UserRole enum for use within a software project. The User class includes properties mapped to database columns, such as Id, LastLoginAt, SubjectId, Email, Username, Personal Details, Role, and configuration flags like Active and MfaEnabled. It extends a base class TimestampedEntity and utilizes data annotations for ORM configuration.

classes.name: User
classes.description: An entity class representing a user in the system with properties mapped to database columns and validation attributes.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: An enumeration defining the possible roles a user can have within the system.
